findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body: When the user and document belong to different tenants, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` unconditionally. This permits cross-tenant document access and bypasses the authorization boundary previously enforced by comparing the tenant identifiers.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document reads
findings.body:
For any differing `userTenant` and `documentTenant`, the function now returns `true`, allowing cross-tenant document access and creating an authorization bypass.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the exported document label contract
findings.body:
Consumers comparing, serializing, or snapshot-testing the exported value `"Document"` now receive `"Document record"`, breaking the existing public data contract.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now grants access unconditionally. Any caller passing unequal tenant IDs—such as `userTenant = "attacker"` and `documentTenant = "victim"`—will permit cross-tenant document reads, bypassing the prior authorization boundary.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
